name: Indian National Congress
founders: Allan Octavian Hume, Dadabhai Naoroji, Dinshaw Wacha and others; first president W. C. Bonnerjee
mission: Describes itself as committed to secularism, democratic socialism and inclusive welfare, building on its role in the independence movement.

leaders.name: Jawaharlal Nehru
leaders.quote: At the stroke of the midnight hour, when the world sleeps, India will awake to life and freedom.

leaders.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri
leaders.quote: Jai Jawan, Jai Kisan (Hail the soldier, hail the farmer)

events.title: Founded in Bombay
events.body: The first session is held in Bombay with 72 delegates; W. C. Bonnerjee presides.

events.title: Purna Swaraj resolution
events.body: At the Lahore session the party adopts complete independence as its goal.

events.title: Forms independent India's first government
events.body: Jawaharlal Nehru becomes the first Prime Minister.

events.title: Party splits
events.body: The party divides into Congress (R), led by Indira Gandhi, and Congress (O).

events.title: Loses power for the first time
events.body: After the Emergency, the party loses the general election to the Janata Party.

events.title: Returns to power
events.body: Indira Gandhi becomes Prime Minister again after the 1980 general election.

events.title: Leads the UPA government
events.body: Manmohan Singh becomes Prime Minister of a coalition government.

events.title: Reduced to 44 seats
events.body: Its lowest Lok Sabha tally at the time.

events.title: Wins 99 seats
events.body: The party becomes the largest opposition party; Rahul Gandhi becomes Leader of the Opposition.

promises.text: Fill about 30 lakh vacant central government posts.
A right to apprenticeship: a one-year paid apprenticeship of Rs 1 lakh for graduates and diploma holders under 25.
Mahalakshmi scheme: Rs 1 lakh a year to every poor family, paid to the eldest woman.
A legal guarantee for minimum support prices (MSP) as recommended by the Swaminathan Commission.
A nationwide socio-economic and caste census.
A constitutional amendment to raise the 50% cap on reservations for SC, ST and OBC.
Scrap the Agnipath scheme and return to regular army recruitment.
A national minimum wage of Rs 400 a day, including under MGNREGA.
NYAY: Rs 72,000 a year to the poorest 20% of families (about 5 crore families).
Fill 22 lakh vacant government posts by March 2020.
A separate 'Kisan budget' for agriculture every year.
Omit the sedition offence (Section 124A) from the Indian Penal Code.
33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and state assemblies.
